storage: Cool, dry cupboard before opening; after opening keep the cap tight and use within a few months (fridge helps with brewed types).
looksLike: A thin, salty, dark-brown liquid in a plastic or glass bottle.
howToPick: Clear dark brown, no sediment, intact seal, within best-before. Check the label: "naturally brewed" is different from the cheaper acid-hydrolysed vegetable protein types. Avoid bottles with a bulging cap or a sour, off smell.
shelfLife: Unopened about 1–2 years; opened bottles last several months (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Pinch of salt plus a few drops of dark soy/Worcestershire
Salt plus a little vinegar and a pinch of sugar

usedIn.raw: 13 ml per serving in all (5 ml in the marinade, 8 ml in the sauce); the Gluten-free variant swaps it for tamari

mergeNotes: Range 169.3–325.9 was wider than 30% of avg 261.9; narrowed to ±15%.
